Day-0 adaptation of Kimi-K3 on Huawei Ascend 910C, built on the Ascend CANN software stack and the forward-looking PyPTO tile DSL

### Test
Run on each node with node-rank 0/1/2.
Cluster: 3× Atlas 800I A3 = 48× Ascend 910C

MODEL_PATH=Kimi-K3-weight
source /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh
source /usr/local/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
export HCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=bond0
export GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME=bond0
unset ASCEND_LAUNCH_BLOCKING

python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
  --model-path $MODEL_PATH \
  --attention-backend ascend --device npu --tp-size 48 \
  --cuda-graph-bs 1 2 4 \
  --nnodes 3 \
  --node-rank <0|1|2> \
  --dist-init-addr xxx::5000 \
  --dist-timeout 900 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \

prs.title: [NPU] Day0 Support Kimi-K3 on 910C

prs.body:
## Overview

Add Kimi K3 model support to vllm-ascend, including the model architecture, KDA attention, quantized MoE execution, multimodal processing, tool-call parsing, KV-cache integration, and Ascend custom operators.

## Key Components

1. Model Architecture and Hybrid Attention (`vllm_ascend/models/`, `vllm_ascend/core/`, `vllm_ascend/attention/`)
   - Adds the Kimi K3 text network, model registration, hybrid KV-cache specifications, MLA no-RoPE handling, and output gating
   - Integrates MLA/KDA layers, MoE routing, quantized expert execution, and model-specific rotary embeddings

2. KDA/GDN Attention and Recurrent State (`vllm_ascend/ops/`, `csrc/attention/`, `csrc/moe/chunk_gated_delta_rule_fwd_h/`)
   - Adds KDA orchestration and recurrent-state management for prefill, decode, variable-length sequences, and graph capture
   - Adds chunk KDA, recurrent KDA, gate cumulative-sum, layout-swap, and chunk gated-delta-rule operators across AscendC and Triton paths
   - Pre-packs causal-convolution weights during the standard post-load lifecycle and preserves the packed parameter across full and kernel-format checkpoint reloads

3. Quantized MoE, SiTU, and Parallel Execution (`vllm_ascend/ops/fused_moe/`, `vllm_ascend/quantization/`, `csrc/moe/`)
   - Adds SiTU MX quantization and dequantization kernels and integrates the Kimi K3 quantized expert execution paths
   - Extends ModelSlim and compressed-tensors mappings and supports the greater-than-512-expert AllGather fallback
   - Decouples shared-expert DP from FlashComm sequence parallelism, routes FC1 full-rank gates correctly, and validates multistream shared-expert input widths

4. Multimodal and Transformers Utilities (`vllm_ascend/transformers_utils/`, `vllm_ascend/models/`, `vllm_ascend/patch/platform/`)
   - Registers the upstream-aligned Kimi K3 configuration and processor contracts
   - Handles image placeholders, NaViT sizing, multimodal token expansion, preprocessing, media loading, and vision parallelism

5. MLA FIA Split and Graph Execution (`vllm_ascend/attention/`)
   - Splits long decode block tables into fixed FIA shards and merges local outputs with device-side LSE
   - Masks graph-padding rows and extends MLA, context-parallel, and ACLGraph coverage for the split path

6. GQA DSpark Speculative Decoding (`vllm_ascend/spec_decode/`, `vllm_ascend/worker/`)
   - Adds fixed-width Kimi K3 GQA DSpark support with auxiliary-state capture and KDA metadata propagation
   - Sanitizes graph padding and integrates the proposer with speculative configuration and model-runner execution

7. PD Disaggregation and KV Transfer (`vllm_ascend/distributed/kv_transfer/`)
   - Handles Kimi K3 hybrid linear-attention cache ownership and transfer layout
   - Supports unequal-TP transfer shapes across Mooncake and AscendStore connectors

8. Tokenization, Reasoning, Tool Calls, and Rendering (`vllm_ascend/patch/platform/`)
   - Adds upstream-aligned structural, reasoning, and tool-call parsers together with the Kimi K3 renderer and protocol handling
   - Preserves remote-decode request handling and real-tokenizer compatibility

9. Operator Registration, Runtime Integration, and Coverage (`csrc/torch_binding*.cpp`, `vllm_ascend/`, `tests/`)
   - Registers KDA, gated-delta-rule, and SiTU operators with symbolic Meta implementations for graph capture and compilation
   - Integrates forward context, environment configuration, distributed execution, operator dispatch, and focused unit and single-card operator coverage

prs.body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?

Adds a Kimi-K3 deployment tutorial for vLLM Ascend v0.23.0, including:

- ModelScope W4A8 weight and validated Atlas 800 A3 image references.
- Four-node DP4/TP16/EP64 mixed deployment.
- Sixteen-node prefill-decode separation deployment.
- Functional verification and accuracy/performance evaluation procedures without publishing result data.

This gives v0.23.0 users a complete deployment and validation workflow for Kimi-K3 on Atlas 800 A3.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No. This is a documentation-only update.

### How was this patch tested?

- Markdown lint with markdownlint-cli 0.45.0.
- Strict Sphinx HTML build with warnings treated as errors.
- Repository pre-commit checks passed for ruff, codespell, typos, clang-format, markdownlint, and repository-local checks. Actionlint and shellcheck were not run locally because this PR does not modify workflow or shell files.
